newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 40 Kurdish guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 40 Kurdish guerrillas.

text.p: Security forces have killed 40 separatist Kurdish guerrillas in four days of clashes in southeastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Wednesday.

The office, based in the regional capital of Diyarbakir, said in a statement the clashes took place in the eastern provinces of Van and Bitlis and the southeastern provinces of Hakkari, Sirnak, Diyarbakir, Mardin and Tunceli.
It did not give any military casualties for the fighting.

More than 25,000 people have died in the 12 year of conflict between troops and the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas, who are fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
